metric_definitions.label: Slice completed
metric_definitions.definition: Slice workflow tasks whose status is slice_completed.

metric_definitions.label: Error videos confirmed
metric_definitions.definition: Slice workflow tasks whose status is video_error_confirmed.

metric_definitions.label: Assignment batches
metric_definitions.definition: Rows in assignment_batches within the actor scope.

metric_definitions.label: Error-video output duration
metric_definitions.definition: Duration credited from error_video_output_details, not inferred from task status.

metric_definitions.label: Slice assignable remaining duration
metric_definitions.definition: Current frame-derived pending-assign backlog duration for slice workflow. Global scope uses the ungrouped platform pool; group scope uses this group's unassigned inventory. Not limited by the dashboard date range.

metric_definitions.label: Description assignable remaining duration
metric_definitions.definition: Current frame-derived pending-assign backlog duration for label workflow. Global scope uses the ungrouped platform pool; group scope uses this group's unassigned inventory. Not limited by the dashboard date range.

metric_definitions.label: Label pending plus confirmed error duration
metric_definitions.definition: Frame-derived duration for label_pending_assign tasks plus video_error_confirmed tasks in the actor scope.

metric_definitions.label: Slice rework plus submitted duration
metric_definitions.definition: Frame-derived duration for slice_rework, slice_submitted, and video_error_review tasks in the slice workflow.

metric_definitions.label: Group online members
metric_definitions.definition: Leader-only: online user count for the same visible user set as user-management online_count (auth heartbeat / Redis presence with DB fallback).
